A work permit must be issued comprising of names of workers, date, and
 time, as well as the working site and the towers numbers. If the work
 location is at a great distance, the issuing authority can issue a verbal
 work order by telephone to the work supervisor.

The workers must pass an annual examination/test in live line washing so
 as to ensure their complete understanding of how each piece of equipment
 operates and all the live line washing procedures to ensure their capability
 of performing the job. This must also be written down in workers examination
 registers and the industrial safety card of each worker.

Workers must pass an annual health -check and it must be written down in
 their registers.

Auxiliary protective equipment must be used, such as waterproof overalls,
 non-conductive gloves, goggles, and binoculars.

A written permission given by the supervisor and registered in the work
 permit is essential for any person or piece of equipment to be present at
 the working site.

In case of any change in water pressure the washing technician must
 immediately move the water column away from the insulators and the tower.

It is essential to have a constant and direct communication between the
 work location and the nearest station capable of performing communication
 between the work supervisor and the specific control center.

The following instructions for the live line washing must be taken into
 consideration

Earthing of the equipment used (MPIS document no. TL-023-r0, item
 7) Detecting the wind speed and direction (MPIS document no. TL-023-r0, item 4).

The ground where the work takes place must be leveled and smooth .The
 inclination of the telescope pillar must not exceed 3 degrees.

The diameter of the nozzle, water pressure, and the length of the water
 column, as well as the specific resistance, the length of the water hose
 and the inclination of the nozzle must be as required.

The distance between the telescope and the tower, as well as that
 between the basket and the conductors must not exceed or be less than what
 is required.
The washing process must take place according to the set procedures.
The washing process must stop in any of the following cases:
Rain / thunder / lightning
Extreme wind speed /storms or mist
Night fall or vision not clear

De-energization whether it was caused by the washing process or any
 other reason.
Changing the water pressure.

Workers must not touch or get close to the equipment during the process.
 They must also stay away from any wet ground.

All workers must stay away from the telescope by a distance not less than
 4.5 m.

Work must take place according to the procedures set for cleaning each
 type of tower. Work sequence must take place according to the wind direction
 as well as the instructions of the supervisor.

The supervisor must make sure that each insulator string is entirely clean
 before moving to another one.

Work must be done according to procedures set, and each piece of equipment
 must be place in its proper position.
